claims.claim: Anthropic's Claude designed protein binders and 17 out of 211 tested designs met the criteria for binding to scorpion toxins.
claims.episode_span: Researchers tested 211 of those designs in actual labs, and 17 of them worked well enough to bind tightly to the toxins from scorpions in Mexico, North Africa, and the Middle East.
claims.source_title: Claude Science tackles deadly scorpion stings by designing protein binders from scratch
claims.supporting_quote: Out of more than 318,000 designs, 211 were tested in the lab. Seventeen met the criteria, and the two strongest bind extremely tightly to Cn2, a toxin from a Mexican scorpion.

claims.claim: OpenAI is rolling out a locked chats feature in ChatGPT that lets users move selected conversations into a protected area accessible only through a four-digit PIN or biometric unlock.
claims.episode_span: OpenAI is rolling out a new "locked chats" feature in ChatGPT that lets you move sensitive conversations into a hidden section protected by a four-digit PIN or your phone's fingerprint or Face ID.
claims.supporting_quote: locked chats, which allows users to move selected conversations out of their regular chat history and into a protected area accessible only through a four-digit account PIN

claims.claim: The updated ChatGPT Chrome extension can read content from multiple open tabs at once to compare products, fill forms, or summarize pages.
claims.episode_span: The updated ChatGPT Chrome extension can now read content from multiple open tabs at once and do things like compare products, fill forms, or summarize what you're looking at without you copying and pasting.
claims.supporting_quote: ChatGPT can draw details from multiple open tabs to provide a more complete response

claims.claim: Google is adding Personal Intelligence to Gemini in Android Auto so the AI can use data from Gmail, Calendar, and Maps to answer questions like flight status while driving.
claims.episode_span: Google is adding its Personal Intelligence feature to Gemini in Android Auto so the AI can pull information from your Gmail, Calendar, and Maps to answer questions like flight status or directions to appointments while you drive.
claims.supporting_quote: Gemini in Android Auto and cars with Google built-in can tap into your information across Google apps, including Gmail, Calendar, Maps
